mostWorthwhile.text: The giant impact was most worthwhile: it connected the moon's creation to a real hypothesis while acknowledging uncertainty.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making rain from mist and stone crust was the least clear passage; the crust's role wasn't explained.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see what develops along the tidal shore; the chapter made its vast changes tangible while offering useful scientific qualifications.
